newsitem.title: FRANCE: Essilor in manufacturing deal with Bausch.
newsitem.headline: Essilor in manufacturing deal with Bausch.

text.p: French corrective lens maker Essilor said on Tuesday it had struck a deal with sunglass manufacturer Bausch & Lomb to make organic and polycarbonate corrective lenses for Bausch & Lomb sunglasses, including the Ray-Ban brand.

"The agreement aims to significantly improve the product offering of premium prescription sunglasses and to facilitate their marketing with the support of Bausch & Lomb's leading brand names," Essilor said in a statement.
The new activity will start up in Florida immediately and gradually expand to the rest of the United States during the year.
